heading: Vigil mechanism

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF 76[A] LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS SPECIFIED SECURITIES 77[AND NON-CONVERTIBLE DEBT SECURITIES]

content:
22. (1) The listed entity shall formulate a vigil mechanism 203[/whistle blower policy] for
directors and employees to report genuine concerns.
(2) The vigil mechanism shall provide for adequate safeguards against victimization of
director(s) or employee(s) or any other person who avail the mechanism and also provide
for direct access to the chairperson of the audit committee in appropriate or exceptional
cases.

footnotes.text:
203 Inserted by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Second Amendment) Regulations,
2021 w.e.f. 5.5.2021.
